    Automorphisms of star models #

    Proof of Proposition 4.1, Step 4: "For D and E, root the tree at the trivalent vertex; for odd A, root it at its middle vertex. Every tree automorphism fixes that root."

    • With three arms, every automorphism fixes the centre (fixes_centre_three).
    • For a path (one arm), an automorphism is the identity or the reversal of depths (path_aut); a reversal preserving the parity of depths fixes the middle vertex.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
